ours_preemphasis_off_vs_official_no_pree.conclusion: The STFT, window placement and flavor, power spectra, librosa filterbank, log guard and centered padding are all correct: the whole feature pipeline matches the official extractor to about 4e-4 with preemphasis disabled.

js_preemphasis_applied_externally_then_p.conclusion: Applying the identical preemphasis formula in JS before the preprocessor yields exactly the same error, so our preemphasis arithmetic is not the break.

verified_upstream: The preemphasized signal itself matches the official one sample for sample (max abs 0.0 when compared in Python).
narrowed_to: Something ParakeetFeatureExtractor.__call__ does between padding/preemphasis and _torch_extract_fbank_features, which ParakeetProcessor only delegates to. Our pipeline reproduces the extractor exactly when that extra step is absent.
next_step: Diff the preemphasized tensor that __call__ hands to _torch_extract_fbank_features against the raw-and-preemphasized signal, then compare per-frame power spectra before mel, to isolate the remaining transform in one pass.
evidence_chain: Official __call__ features feed the locally exported ONNX graph and decode to the oracle transcript exactly; the no-preemphasis path decodes to "." only. So the contract is known even though our frontend does not yet reproduce it.
shipped: No preset, adapter or manifest registered for this model.
